speaker: श्रीभगवान्
sanskrit:
युक्तः कर्मफलं त्यक्त्वा शान्तिमाप्नोति नैष्ठिकीम् ।
अयुक्तः कामकारेण फले सक्तो निबध्यते ॥
transliteration:
yuktaḥ karmaphalaṃ tyaktvā śāntimāpnoti naiṣṭhikīm |
ayuktaḥ kāmakāreṇa phale sakto nibadhyate
translation: Giving up the result of work by becoming resolute in faith, one attains Peace arising from steadfastness. One who is lacking in resolute faith, being attached to the result under the impulsion of desire, becomes bound.
hindi: युक्त पुरुष कर्मफल का त्याग करके परम शान्ति को प्राप्त होता है; और अयुक्त पुरुष फल में आसक्त हुआ कामना के द्वारा बँधता है।।
